issues.title: Webhook can reach side effects without visible deduplication
issues.summary: Webhook can reach 2 external side-effect node(s) without an obvious idempotency guard.
issues.whyItMatters: Webhook providers commonly retry deliveries. The same event can therefore create duplicate emails, CRM records, payments or messages.
issues.recommendation: Persist a stable event identifier before side effects, reject already-processed events and only mark success after the business action completes.

issues.title: AI decision appears close to an external side effect
issues.summary: AI output flows directly into: Create HubSpot Contact.
issues.whyItMatters: A hallucinated or malformed model response can immediately trigger messages, writes or external actions.
issues.recommendation: Insert deterministic validation, allow-listing and—where impact is high—human approval before the side effect.

issues.title: External request has no retry strategy
issues.summary: An HTTP request can fail transiently without any retry policy.
issues.whyItMatters: Rate limits, network interruptions and temporary 5xx errors can turn recoverable incidents into lost executions.
issues.recommendation: Enable bounded retries with backoff and route exhausted retries to an error path or queue.

issues.title: External side effects lack visible recovery path
issues.summary: 2 external action node(s) have no obvious retry or recovery strategy.
issues.whyItMatters: Failures after partial external writes can leave systems inconsistent or require manual reconstruction.
issues.recommendation: Add bounded retries, explicit failure handling and a replayable dead-letter mechanism for high-value operations.

issues.title: No workflow-level error workflow configured
issues.summary: No workflow-level error workflow reference was detected.
issues.whyItMatters: Unhandled failures can disappear into execution history instead of entering an operational recovery process.
issues.recommendation: Configure an error workflow that captures context, alerts an owner and preserves enough data for replay.

issues.title: Webhook may be unauthenticated
issues.summary: No obvious authentication or signature-validation configuration was found for this webhook.
issues.whyItMatters: Public webhook endpoints can be invoked by untrusted callers unless the sender is authenticated or the payload is signed.
issues.recommendation: Require authentication or validate a provider signature/HMAC before performing any side effect.

issues.title: AI node may consume untrusted text without visible guardrails
issues.summary: This AI node appears downstream of user-controlled input without an obvious prompt-injection boundary.
issues.whyItMatters: Untrusted content can attempt to override instructions, exfiltrate context or manipulate automated decisions.
issues.recommendation: Separate trusted instructions from untrusted content, minimize tool permissions and validate model outputs independently.

issues.title: Bulk processing may lack batching
issues.summary: A potentially bulk external action is present without an obvious batching node.
issues.whyItMatters: Large item counts can hit provider rate limits, memory pressure or execution time limits.
issues.recommendation: Process bounded batches with backoff and checkpoint progress for resumability.

issues.title: HTTP call has no explicit timeout hint
issues.summary: No explicit timeout configuration was found in this HTTP node.
issues.whyItMatters: Slow upstream services can hold executions open and amplify concurrency or queue pressure.
issues.recommendation: Set a finite request timeout appropriate to the provider and design a timeout recovery path.

issues.title: No obvious validation layer detected
issues.summary: External input enters the workflow without an obvious validation/sanitization stage.
issues.whyItMatters: Unexpected nulls, wrong types and malicious payloads can propagate deep into integrations before failing.
issues.recommendation: Validate required fields, types, allowed values and size limits near the workflow boundary.

issues.title: No replay/dead-letter mechanism detected
issues.summary: No explicit failed-event queue or replay mechanism was detected.
issues.whyItMatters: Manual recovery becomes difficult when transient incidents affect many events or external writes are only partially completed.
issues.recommendation: Persist failed event context in a replayable store for critical workflows.

issues.title: Possible personal data sent to AI provider
issues.summary: Prompt/configuration references fields commonly associated with personal data.
issues.whyItMatters: Sending personal data to a model provider can create privacy, retention or contractual obligations depending on the use case.
issues.recommendation: Minimize data sent to the model, redact unnecessary identifiers and verify the provider configuration fits your privacy requirements.

issues.title: Hard-coded notification recipient
issues.summary: A fixed email address appears directly in node parameters.
issues.whyItMatters: Hard-coded recipients make environment changes and team ownership transitions easy to miss.
issues.recommendation: Move operational recipients to configuration unless the address is intentionally part of the business logic.

issues.title: High-impact node is undocumented
issues.summary: This high-impact integration has no node notes.
issues.whyItMatters: Operational context, invariants and provider assumptions are easily lost when workflows change hands.
issues.recommendation: Document purpose, failure expectations and any non-obvious assumptions directly on the node.

issues.title: No pinned example data detected
issues.summary: The export contains no pinned example data.
issues.whyItMatters: Pinned data is not required in production, but realistic fixtures can make regression testing and review easier during development.
issues.recommendation: Maintain representative test fixtures outside production if you intentionally avoid pinning data in the workflow.

issues.title: Workflow lacks visible version/change note
issues.summary: No human-readable version/change marker was detected.
issues.whyItMatters: Automation changes can alter external behavior without the deployment discipline commonly used for application code.
issues.recommendation: Keep workflow JSON in source control and document meaningful production changes.
